<python>
if 'start' in globals():
    start('B', 'idle-arm tick log')
r = locate('red button; blue button')
reds = sorted([o for o in r['objects'] if 'red' in o['name']], key=lambda o: o['position'][0])
blue = [o for o in r['objects'] if 'blue' in o['name']][0]
print('reds', [o['position'] for o in reds], 'blue', blue['position'])
</python>

Park the right arm above the blue button, press the middle red button with the left arm twice, logging every tick: both link6 heights and the right arm's commanded and measured joints.
<python>
S = press.__self__
log = []
_orig = S._tick
def _logged_tick(command, cameras=None):
    out = _orig(command, cameras=cameras)
    st = out['state']
    j = st['joint_position']
    log.append((st['step'], round(st['left_ee_pose'][2], 4), round(st['right_ee_pose'][2], 4), round(max(abs(command[i] - j[i]) for i in range(0, 6)), 3), round(max(abs(command[i] - j[i]) for i in range(7, 13)), 3)))
    return out
S._tick = _logged_tick
m = move_tip('right', blue['position'][0], blue['position'][1], 0.765 + 0.058)
print('right parked', m['tip'], m['event'])
for k in range(2):
    p = press(reds[-1]['position'], times=1, arm='left_arm')
    print('left press', k, p)
print('ticks logged', len(log))
</python>
